heroes.name: Ana
heroes.biography: An Egyptian veteran sniper who supports allies from range.

abilities.name: Biotic Rifle
abilities.description: Shots can heal allies or damage enemies. Scoped shots use a different aiming mode.

abilities.name: Sleep Dart
abilities.description: A projectile that puts an enemy to sleep; damage can wake them.

abilities.name: Biotic Grenade
abilities.description: A thrown explosive with healing, damage, and healing-denial effects.

abilities.name: Nano Boost
abilities.description: Empowers a selected ally for an engagement.

guides.title: Build a safe position
guides.body: Keep an ally and a retreat corner in view. Avoid angles where only the enemy can reach you.
guides.drill: Play one match and record three moments where cover would have kept you safe.

guides.title: Manage your resources
guides.body: Save Sleep Dart when a diver is approaching. Use Biotic Grenade when your team can act on the healing denial.
guides.drill: Review three deaths and identify the defensive ability you spent too early.

guides.title: Coordinate the engagement
guides.body: Coordinate Nano Boost before the fight. Track cleansing and defensive abilities before committing your grenade.
guides.drill: Before each fight, name your target and your exit route. Review whether both were realistic.

heroes.name: Anran
heroes.biography: A graduate of Wuxing University's Fire College who specializes in fire attacks.

guides.title: Build a useful position
guides.body: Approach from cover with a route back to your team. Use your fire projectiles to establish pressure before committing movement toward an enemy.
guides.drill: Review one match. Pause before three engagements and identify your cover, useful target, and retreat route.

guides.title: Choose the right resource
guides.body: Fan the Flames interacts with burning targets. Check that the target is affected before spending the follow-up, and use Dancing Blaze when nearby enemies make its defensive and healing effects useful.
guides.drill: Record three uses of the named ability. Explain the threat it answered and the option you lost by spending it.

guides.title: Coordinate the commitment
guides.body: Plan where Inferno Rush or Vermillion Ascent will leave you. If using Vermillion Revival, judge the surviving enemy pressure rather than assuming a return will make the original engagement safe.
guides.drill: Before three fights, tell a teammate what opening you want and which defensive answer would stop it. Review whether you waited for that answer.

heroes.name: Ashe
heroes.biography: A Deadlock gang leader who fights with a rifle and explosives.

guides.title: Build a useful position
guides.body: Aim from cover with The Viper and leave Coach Gun available if a diver reaches you. A useful angle needs an exit as well as a target.
guides.drill: Review one match. Pause before three engagements and identify your cover, useful target, and retreat route.

guides.title: Choose the right resource
guides.body: Shoot Dynamite when its explosion can pressure several enemies or force them out of cover. Do not stay scoped when your position is being contested.
guides.drill: Record three uses of the named ability. Explain the threat it answered and the option you lost by spending it.

guides.title: Coordinate the commitment
guides.body: Place B.O.B. where his line of fire complements your team's angle. Announce the deployment and watch for abilities that can shut him down.
guides.drill: Before three fights, tell a teammate what opening you want and which defensive answer would stop it. Review whether you waited for that answer.

heroes.name: Baptiste
heroes.biography: A former Talon medic who now uses his combat training to help people harmed by war.

guides.title: Build a useful position
guides.body: Choose a position where your healing projectiles can reach the team without exposing you to every enemy sightline. Use Exo Boots to reach useful cover, rather than jumping constantly.
guides.drill: Review one match. Pause before three engagements and identify your cover, useful target, and retreat route.

guides.title: Choose the right resource
guides.body: Place Immortality Field where allies can use it and enemies cannot immediately destroy it. Rotate healing and rifle pressure without letting an ally's emergency go unnoticed.
guides.drill: Record three uses of the named ability. Explain the threat it answered and the option you lost by spending it.

guides.title: Coordinate the commitment
guides.body: Amplification Matrix needs a usable firing lane. Communicate its position before the fight and do not force teammates to abandon cover just to shoot through it.
guides.drill: Before three fights, tell a teammate what opening you want and which defensive answer would stop it. Review whether you waited for that answer.

heroes.name: Bastion
heroes.biography: An omnic war machine that became an explorer with an interest in nature.

guides.title: Build a useful position
guides.body: Use Recon to move between protected positions. Enter Assault when a target will remain in your line of fire, rather than when the whole enemy team can simply hide.
guides.drill: Review one match. Pause before three engagements and identify your cover, useful target, and retreat route.

guides.title: Choose the right resource
guides.body: Keep a corner or teammate between you and a coordinated flank. Use the grenade to pressure cover, and leave a retreat route before your high-pressure configuration ends.
guides.drill: Record three uses of the named ability. Explain the threat it answered and the option you lost by spending it.

guides.title: Coordinate the commitment
guides.body: Artillery commits your position. Start it from safety and place shots around the enemy's likely movement and escape choices; treat forcing a rotation as useful pressure.
guides.drill: Before three fights, tell a teammate what opening you want and which defensive answer would stop it. Review whether you waited for that answer.

heroes.name: Brigitte
heroes.biography: An engineer who took up arms to defend others alongside Reinhardt.

guides.title: Build a useful position
guides.body: Stay near allies who need protection. Use Whip Shot to discourage an approach instead of walking alone into enemy close-range damage.
guides.drill: Review one match. Pause before three engagements and identify your cover, useful target, and retreat route.

guides.title: Choose the right resource
guides.body: Manage Repair Packs according to who is under immediate threat. Use your shield and movement to survive a duel while keeping Inspire opportunities safe.
guides.drill: Record three uses of the named ability. Explain the threat it answered and the option you lost by spending it.

guides.title: Coordinate the commitment
guides.body: Watch the enemy dive timing and answer it together with your other support. Rally is a team engagement resource; choose a fight your nearby allies can participate in.
guides.drill: Before three fights, tell a teammate what opening you want and which defensive answer would stop it. Review whether you waited for that answer.

heroes.name: Cassidy
heroes.biography: An outlaw gunslinger who uses a revolver to carry out his own idea of justice.

guides.title: Build a useful position
guides.body: Take a covered angle where Peacekeeper can threaten the enemy while you remain close enough for teammate help. Avoid chasing mobile targets into isolated routes.
guides.drill: Review one match. Pause before three engagements and identify your cover, useful target, and retreat route.

guides.title: Choose the right resource
guides.body: Treat Combat Roll as a resource for survival and a timely reload. Aim to finish a realistic target rather than spending the whole fight shooting a protected tank.
guides.drill: Record three uses of the named ability. Explain the threat it answered and the option you lost by spending it.

guides.title: Coordinate the commitment
guides.body: Deadeye announces a threat and exposes your position. Check cover, interruption threats, and escape routes before activating it; forcing enemies away can matter even without an elimination.
guides.drill: Before three fights, tell a teammate what opening you want and which defensive answer would stop it. Review whether you waited for that answer.

heroes.name: D.Mon
heroes.biography: The new leader of MEKA, a Korean mech team, who coordinates allies in close fighting.

guides.title: Build a useful position
guides.body: Use Power Barrier to cover a useful approach while staying near hard cover. A frontal barrier does not protect every side of your mech.
guides.drill: Review one match. Pause before three engagements and identify your cover, useful target, and retreat route.

guides.title: Choose the right resource
guides.body: Surging Strike requires the barrier stance. Plan that transition and use Propulsors with a landing route in mind, budgeting the fuel you will need to return to your team.
guides.drill: Record three uses of the named ability. Explain the threat it answered and the option you lost by spending it.

guides.title: Coordinate the commitment
guides.body: Limit Break creates a sweeping engagement opportunity that benefits from coordinated pressure. If the mech is lost, play the pilot's weapon and return-to-mech plan from safety rather than continuing the same frontline commitment.
guides.drill: Before three fights, tell a teammate what opening you want and which defensive answer would stop it. Review whether you waited for that answer.

heroes.name: D.Va
heroes.biography: A Korean pilot who uses a mobile mech to contest space and protect teammates.

abilities.name: Defense Matrix
abilities.description: Intercepts eligible incoming projectiles; it does not stop all damage types.

guides.title: Build a safe position
guides.body: Use boosters to reach a useful angle and return to your team before overextending.
guides.drill: Play one match and record three moments where cover would have kept you safe.

guides.title: Manage your resources
guides.body: Intercept an important projectile rather than spending all of Defense Matrix on harmless poke.
guides.drill: Review three deaths and identify the defensive ability you spent too early.

guides.title: Coordinate the engagement
guides.body: Switch between diving and peeling as enemy threats change. Keep an escape plan when your mech is pressured.
guides.drill: Before each fight, name your target and your exit route. Review whether both were realistic.

heroes.name: Doctrine
heroes.biography: A cyberneticist who uses a drone fleet to control healing, pressure, and movement.

guides.title: Build a useful position
guides.body: Use Eternal Scepter from a covered angle where you can help allies and pressure enemies. Watch the team's immediate support need before planning an offensive sequence.
guides.drill: Review one match. Pause before three engagements and identify your cover, useful target, and retreat route.

guides.title: Choose the right resource
guides.body: Infuse changes the next ability. Choose that ability deliberately: an empowered attack, ally drones with self support, or a flight option can answer different threats.
guides.drill: Record three uses of the named ability. Explain the threat it answered and the option you lost by spending it.

guides.title: Coordinate the commitment
guides.body: Coordinate Deliverance with teammate pressure while monitoring who needs its protective overhealth. Shrouded Momentum can reposition you; keep a destination and an exit instead of using movement as a substitute for a safe plan.
guides.drill: Before three fights, tell a teammate what opening you want and which defensive answer would stop it. Review whether you waited for that answer.

heroes.name: Domina
heroes.biography: A Vishkar negotiator who uses hard-light barriers and controlled pressure.

guides.title: Build a useful position
guides.body: Use the Barrier Array to divide useful enemy sightlines. Keep a covered position from which Photon Magnum can threaten a target without exposing your whole team.
guides.drill: Review one match. Pause before three engagements and identify your cover, useful target, and retreat route.

guides.title: Choose the right resource
guides.body: Sonic Repulsors become more threatening around walls. Check the target's nearby geometry and line up an opportunity your allies can exploit instead of pushing a target out of their reach.
guides.drill: Record three uses of the named ability. Explain the threat it answered and the option you lost by spending it.

guides.title: Coordinate the commitment
guides.body: Plan a Crystal Charge detonation around enemy movement. Panopticon is a committed space-control tool; use it when teammate pressure can capitalize on the trapped area.
guides.drill: Before three fights, tell a teammate what opening you want and which defensive answer would stop it. Review whether you waited for that answer.

heroes.name: Doomfist
heroes.biography: A former Talon leader who uses a powerful gauntlet and committed movement.

guides.title: Build a useful position
guides.body: Choose a destination and an exit before using Seismic Slam or Rocket Punch. A deep landing without support is a risk even when the first hit connects.
guides.drill: Review one match. Pause before three engagements and identify your cover, useful target, and retreat route.

guides.title: Choose the right resource
guides.body: Use Power Block when enemies have a reason to damage you, and watch for attacks it cannot safely answer. Keep a movement resource to leave after creating pressure.
guides.drill: Record three uses of the named ability. Explain the threat it answered and the option you lost by spending it.

guides.title: Coordinate the commitment
guides.body: Coordinate displacement with an ally's line of fire. Meteor Strike can change your position as well as threaten a target; reassess the enemy's defensive resources before landing.
guides.drill: Before three fights, tell a teammate what opening you want and which defensive answer would stop it. Review whether you waited for that answer.

heroes.name: Echo
heroes.biography: An adaptive omnic created by Overwatch scientist Mina Liao.

guides.title: Build a useful position
guides.body: Use Flight to reach an angle with cover and a path back to your team. Do not hover in a predictable open sightline just because you can stay airborne.
guides.drill: Review one match. Pause before three engagements and identify your cover, useful target, and retreat route.

guides.title: Choose the right resource
guides.body: Combine projectile pressure and Sticky Bombs to make a realistic finishing opportunity for Focusing Beam. If the target receives help, disengage instead of tunneling on the original plan.
guides.drill: Record three uses of the named ability. Explain the threat it answered and the option you lost by spending it.

guides.title: Coordinate the commitment
guides.body: Choose a Duplicate target whose abilities you can use well in the current fight. Consider where the copied kit will leave you when the transformation ends.
guides.drill: Before three fights, tell a teammate what opening you want and which defensive answer would stop it. Review whether you waited for that answer.

heroes.name: Emre
heroes.biography: A former Overwatch operative who returned after unexplained changes to his body and mind.

guides.title: Build a useful position
guides.body: Use the Synthetic Burst Rifle from a protected angle. Aim and movement choices should keep a target available without making your own position predictable.
guides.drill: Review one match. Pause before three engagements and identify your cover, useful target, and retreat route.

guides.title: Choose the right resource
guides.body: Cyber Frag has a bouncing trajectory. Choose a surface and follow-up target rather than throwing it into a route no enemy needs to use.
guides.drill: Record three uses of the named ability. Explain the threat it answered and the option you lost by spending it.

guides.title: Coordinate the commitment
guides.body: Override Protocol changes the commitment you can make. Review the form's current in-game mechanics before engaging and keep your team's sightlines in mind as you reposition.
guides.drill: Before three fights, tell a teammate what opening you want and which defensive answer would stop it. Review whether you waited for that answer.

heroes.name: Freja
heroes.biography: A former rescue operative who became a professional bounty hunter.

guides.title: Build a useful position
guides.body: Use Take Aim from a position where slowing your movement is safe. Keep an escape or reposition option when enemies can see the angle you are using.
guides.drill: Review one match. Pause before three engagements and identify your cover, useful target, and retreat route.

guides.title: Choose the right resource
guides.body: Quick Dash refreshes Take Aim in the official kit description. Plan the movement and follow-up shot together instead of dashing without a useful new angle.
guides.drill: Record three uses of the named ability. Explain the threat it answered and the option you lost by spending it.

guides.title: Coordinate the commitment
guides.body: Bola Shot can create a grouping opportunity. Use Updraft and your firing lane to time it with teammate pressure, while watching who can contest your airborne position.
guides.drill: Before three fights, tell a teammate what opening you want and which defensive answer would stop it. Review whether you waited for that answer.

heroes.name: Genji
heroes.biography: A cybernetic ninja who creates pressure with mobility and precise projectiles.

abilities.name: Deflect
abilities.description: Redirects eligible incoming attacks; some attack types cannot be deflected.

abilities.name: Dragonblade
abilities.description: A close-range sword ultimate that requires an engagement plan.

guides.title: Build a safe position
guides.body: Poke from cover until a target is isolated. Keep a route back to your team.
guides.drill: Play one match and record three moments where cover would have kept you safe.

guides.title: Manage your resources
guides.body: Do not dash into the whole enemy team for minor damage. Check defensive abilities before engaging.
guides.drill: Review three deaths and identify the defensive ability you spent too early.

guides.title: Coordinate the engagement
guides.body: Coordinate a flank with your tank. Track enemy control effects before Dragonblade.
guides.drill: Before each fight, name your target and your exit route. Review whether both were realistic.

heroes.name: Hanzo
heroes.biography: A Shimada archer who seeks a new path after his family's conflict.

guides.title: Build a useful position
guides.body: Aim at routes enemies actually use and move after revealing your firing position. Wall Climb gives you access to angles, but it does not make an exposed ledge safe.
guides.drill: Review one match. Pause before three engagements and identify your cover, useful target, and retreat route.

guides.title: Choose the right resource
guides.body: Use Sonic Arrow to check a threatened approach or set up your team's next action. Save Storm Arrows for a target you can keep in view rather than spending them into protected space.
guides.drill: Record three uses of the named ability. Explain the threat it answered and the option you lost by spending it.

guides.title: Coordinate the commitment
guides.body: Dragonstrike can cut off a route or support a coordinated engagement. Pair its path with teammate pressure so enemies cannot avoid it at no cost.
guides.drill: Before three fights, tell a teammate what opening you want and which defensive answer would stop it. Review whether you waited for that answer.

heroes.name: Hazard
heroes.biography: An underworld disruptor who fights with spikes, movement, and a temporary wall.

guides.title: Build a useful position
guides.body: Close distance using cover and short terrain access. Choose where Violent Leap will land before committing to close pressure.
guides.drill: Review one match. Pause before three engagements and identify your cover, useful target, and retreat route.

guides.title: Choose the right resource
guides.body: Jagged Wall can alter a target's movement and sightlines. Place it to support your team's action rather than blocking allied healing or trapping yourself beyond cover.
guides.drill: Record three uses of the named ability. Explain the threat it answered and the option you lost by spending it.

guides.title: Coordinate the commitment
guides.body: Use Spike Guard against useful frontal pressure while tracking threats from other angles. Downpour creates an engagement opportunity that needs teammate follow-up, not a reason to leap alone into the whole enemy team.
guides.drill: Before three fights, tell a teammate what opening you want and which defensive answer would stop it. Review whether you waited for that answer.

heroes.name: Illari
heroes.biography: A survivor of the Inti Warriors who uses solar-powered support technology.

guides.title: Build a useful position
guides.body: Place Healing Pylon behind cover where its healing can reach useful allies. Keep a backup position if enemies identify and destroy it.
guides.drill: Review one match. Pause before three engagements and identify your cover, useful target, and retreat route.

guides.title: Choose the right resource
guides.body: Balance charged rifle pressure with your healing beam's resource. Outburst can create separation from a threat; do not spend it merely to move faster into danger.
guides.drill: Record three uses of the named ability. Explain the threat it answered and the option you lost by spending it.

guides.title: Coordinate the commitment
guides.body: Plan a Captive Sun engagement with teammate follow-up and an escape. Marking enemies is not enough if your team cannot safely apply the needed pressure.
guides.drill: Before three fights, tell a teammate what opening you want and which defensive answer would stop it. Review whether you waited for that answer.

heroes.name: Jetpack Cat
heroes.biography: A feline pilot using jet technology designed by Brigitte.

guides.title: Build a useful position
guides.body: Use Biotic Pawjectiles from an angle that reaches allies while leaving an aerial escape. Keep terrain between you and enemy firing lanes rather than relying on flight alone.
guides.drill: Review one match. Pause before three engagements and identify your cover, useful target, and retreat route.

guides.title: Choose the right resource
guides.body: Lifeline moves another player, so agree on a safe transport destination. Carrying an ally changes fuel recovery; budget Frenetic Flight around that commitment.
guides.drill: Record three uses of the named ability. Explain the threat it answered and the option you lost by spending it.

guides.title: Coordinate the commitment
guides.body: Use Purr where allies need its area healing and enemies can be displaced usefully. Catnapper changes an enemy's position; choose the landing and your own follow-up route before diving.
guides.drill: Before three fights, tell a teammate what opening you want and which defensive answer would stop it. Review whether you waited for that answer.

heroes.name: Junker Queen
heroes.biography: The ruler of Junkertown, known for close-range combat and her axe.

guides.title: Build a useful position
guides.body: Fight around corners where you can close distance without absorbing every ranged attack. Stay close enough for allies to help when you commit to a target.
guides.drill: Review one match. Pause before three engagements and identify your cover, useful target, and retreat route.

guides.title: Choose the right resource
guides.body: Use Commanding Shout to support a meaningful engagement or retreat. Line up Carnage when enemies are actually within reach, rather than stepping into their whole team for one hit.
guides.drill: Record three uses of the named ability. Explain the threat it answered and the option you lost by spending it.

guides.title: Coordinate the commitment
guides.body: Rampage needs a route, a target group, and teammate follow-up. Track defensive answers to healing denial and avoid ending the charge beyond your team's support.
guides.drill: Before three fights, tell a teammate what opening you want and which defensive answer would stop it. Review whether you waited for that answer.

heroes.name: Junkrat
heroes.biography: A demolitionist whose explosives create pressure around obstacles.

guides.title: Build a useful position
guides.body: Use bounced shots to pressure a route while keeping your body protected. A trap is most useful where an enemy has a reason to walk, not where it is easy to spot and shoot.
guides.drill: Review one match. Pause before three engagements and identify your cover, useful target, and retreat route.

guides.title: Choose the right resource
guides.body: Reserve a Concussion Mine for movement if enemies can reach you. Avoid spending all your escape options to finish a target your team could safely pressure instead.
guides.drill: Record three uses of the named ability. Explain the threat it answered and the option you lost by spending it.

guides.title: Coordinate the commitment
guides.body: Start RIP-Tire from a position enemies cannot immediately reach. Choose a path that threatens a valuable group, and be ready to move your own body when the ultimate ends.
guides.drill: Before three fights, tell a teammate what opening you want and which defensive answer would stop it. Review whether you waited for that answer.

heroes.name: Juno
heroes.biography: A Martian-born support using space technology to protect her team and help her home.

guides.title: Build a useful position
guides.body: Keep a line where Mediblaster can help allies and threaten enemies. Use hover and movement near cover rather than remaining in a steady open aerial position.
guides.drill: Review one match. Pause before three engagements and identify your cover, useful target, and retreat route.

guides.title: Choose the right resource
guides.body: Pulsar Torpedoes need a useful lock-on opportunity. Place Hyper Ring on a route the team intends to use, and communicate that route instead of expecting a ring to create a plan on its own.
guides.drill: Record three uses of the named ability. Explain the threat it answered and the option you lost by spending it.

guides.title: Coordinate the commitment
guides.body: Orbital Ray moves through space. Start it along your team's intended engagement and keep Glide Boost for the repositioning that the moving fight requires.
guides.drill: Before three fights, tell a teammate what opening you want and which defensive answer would stop it. Review whether you waited for that answer.

heroes.name: Kiriko
heroes.biography: A Kanezaka protector who combines healing with precise projectiles.

abilities.name: Swift Step
abilities.description: Repositions to an ally; check the destination before committing.

abilities.name: Protection Suzu
abilities.description: Provides a short defensive effect and removes eligible negative effects.

guides.title: Build a safe position
guides.body: Stand where you can heal your team and retreat. Check an ally is safe before teleporting.
guides.drill: Play one match and record three moments where cover would have kept you safe.

guides.title: Manage your resources
guides.body: Reserve Protection Suzu for a threat that matters rather than small chip damage.
guides.drill: Review three deaths and identify the defensive ability you spent too early.

guides.title: Coordinate the engagement
guides.body: Alternate healing with safe projectile pressure. Plan a rush path your team can actually use.
guides.drill: Before each fight, name your target and your exit route. Review whether both were realistic.

heroes.name: Lifeweaver
heroes.biography: The inventor of biolight, a technology that combines living forms with hard light.

guides.title: Build a useful position
guides.body: Keep healing sightlines and use cover while charging Healing Blossom. A safe Petal Platform can give you or an ally a new angle without forcing a risky walk.
guides.drill: Review one match. Pause before three engagements and identify your cover, useful target, and retreat route.

guides.title: Choose the right resource
guides.body: Life Grip changes another player's position. Watch the threat first and communicate a rescue plan, rather than interrupting a teammate's successful engagement.
guides.drill: Record three uses of the named ability. Explain the threat it answered and the option you lost by spending it.

guides.title: Coordinate the commitment
guides.body: Use Tree of Life to sustain a contested area your team can actually hold. Keep track of your allies' escape routes so your protection adds choices instead of replacing their judgment.
guides.drill: Before three fights, tell a teammate what opening you want and which defensive answer would stop it. Review whether you waited for that answer.

heroes.name: Lúcio
heroes.biography: A musician and activist who supports his team through movement and music.

guides.title: Build a useful position
guides.body: Move with allies who benefit from your current song. Wall Ride is a tool to keep useful angles and avoid pressure, not a reason to leave the team without support.
guides.drill: Review one match. Pause before three engagements and identify your cover, useful target, and retreat route.

guides.title: Choose the right resource
guides.body: Choose healing or speed according to the team's immediate need. Amp It Up is stronger when it answers a committed move or a real recovery window.
guides.drill: Record three uses of the named ability. Explain the threat it answered and the option you lost by spending it.

guides.title: Coordinate the commitment
guides.body: Plan Sound Barrier around a dangerous enemy commitment and your allies' positions. Soundwave can separate an attacker from a vulnerable teammate without requiring a solo chase.
guides.drill: Before three fights, tell a teammate what opening you want and which defensive answer would stop it. Review whether you waited for that answer.

heroes.name: Mauga
heroes.biography: A Samoan fighter who uses heavy pressure and thrives in a direct confrontation.

guides.title: Build a useful position
guides.body: Use cover while closing distance. Stay aware of support sightlines before Overrun carries you forward; reaching an enemy is not the same as being able to survive there.
guides.drill: Review one match. Pause before three engagements and identify your cover, useful target, and retreat route.

guides.title: Choose the right resource
guides.body: Cardiac Overdrive rewards a fight your nearby allies can participate in. Use its window when targets are available and defensive resources have not already stopped your pressure.
guides.drill: Record three uses of the named ability. Explain the threat it answered and the option you lost by spending it.

guides.title: Coordinate the commitment
guides.body: Cage Fight can also trap you in a bad situation. Check who will be inside, who can support from outside, and whether your team is ready to commit.
guides.drill: Before three fights, tell a teammate what opening you want and which defensive answer would stop it. Review whether you waited for that answer.

heroes.name: Mei
heroes.biography: A climate scientist who uses ice technology to shape a fight.

guides.title: Build a useful position
guides.body: Stay near cover and use your close pressure to protect an area your team can support. Long-range icicles let you contribute without walking into every enemy threat.
guides.drill: Review one match. Pause before three engagements and identify your cover, useful target, and retreat route.

guides.title: Choose the right resource
guides.body: Use Ice Wall to isolate a reachable target or interrupt a threatening sightline. Avoid blocking an ally's escape or healing; be ready to remove an unhelpful wall.
guides.drill: Record three uses of the named ability. Explain the threat it answered and the option you lost by spending it.

guides.title: Coordinate the commitment
guides.body: Choose Blizzard when your team can pressure the area and follow up. Keep track of escape and defensive abilities, and use Cryo-Freeze from a position you can leave afterward.
guides.drill: Before three fights, tell a teammate what opening you want and which defensive answer would stop it. Review whether you waited for that answer.

heroes.name: Mercy
heroes.biography: A Swiss doctor who follows allies with mobile single-target support.

abilities.name: Guardian Angel
abilities.description: Fly toward an ally and use movement to choose a safe landing.

abilities.name: Resurrect
abilities.description: Revives an eliminated ally when the cast can safely complete.

guides.title: Build a safe position
guides.body: Keep a second ally available as an escape route. Use cover while your beam remains connected.
guides.drill: Play one match and record three moments where cover would have kept you safe.

guides.title: Manage your resources
guides.body: Amplify an ally who is actively dealing useful damage; heal when survival demands it.
guides.drill: Review three deaths and identify the defensive ability you spent too early.

guides.title: Coordinate the engagement
guides.body: Check enemy sightlines before Resurrection. A lost resurrection attempt can cost another teammate.
guides.drill: Before each fight, name your target and your exit route. Review whether both were realistic.

heroes.name: Mizuki
heroes.biography: A fighter determined to escape a curse and control his own future.

guides.title: Build a useful position
guides.body: Use Healing Kasa when its bounces can reach allies who need help. Keep a return position near cover before using Katashiro Return to advance.
guides.drill: Review one match. Pause before three engagements and identify your cover, useful target, and retreat route.

guides.title: Choose the right resource
guides.body: Binding Chain can hinder an approaching threat. Coordinate the target with your team and avoid leaving your healing role just to pursue an isolated duel.
guides.drill: Record three uses of the named ability. Explain the threat it answered and the option you lost by spending it.

guides.title: Coordinate the commitment
guides.body: Place Kekkai Sanctuary where allies can use its healing and projectile protection. Consider incoming directions and escape routes; the sanctuary is not a guarantee against every attack type.
guides.drill: Before three fights, tell a teammate what opening you want and which defensive answer would stop it. Review whether you waited for that answer.

heroes.name: Moira
heroes.biography: A genetic researcher whose methods are controversial and whose kit mixes healing and damage.

guides.title: Build a useful position
guides.body: Maintain a position where your healing can reach multiple allies. Use damage safely to manage biotic resources; do not leave endangered teammates to pursue a distant target.
guides.drill: Review one match. Pause before three engagements and identify your cover, useful target, and retreat route.

guides.title: Choose the right resource
guides.body: Choose the orb type for the current fight and consider how surfaces will affect its path. Keep Fade available when enemies have a realistic route to you.
guides.drill: Record three uses of the named ability. Explain the threat it answered and the option you lost by spending it.

guides.title: Coordinate the commitment
guides.body: Line up Coalescence to support allies and pressure enemies together. Track interruption threats and reposition through the beam's duration rather than standing in an exposed lane.
guides.drill: Before three fights, tell a teammate what opening you want and which defensive answer would stop it. Review whether you waited for that answer.

heroes.name: Orisa
heroes.biography: A robot built to protect Numbani and learning how to meet that responsibility.

guides.title: Build a useful position
guides.body: Hold a corner and pressure a reachable target with the Fusion Driver. Let your weapon recover while cover protects you instead of staying exposed until every resource is gone.
guides.drill: Review one match. Pause before three engagements and identify your cover, useful target, and retreat route.

guides.title: Choose the right resource
guides.body: Rotate Fortify and Javelin Spin according to the actual incoming threat. Use Energy Javelin to interrupt or displace a target your team can act on.
guides.drill: Record three uses of the named ability. Explain the threat it answered and the option you lost by spending it.

guides.title: Coordinate the commitment
guides.body: Terra Surge needs nearby targets and a safe commitment. Watch escape routes and teammate pressure; a long charge is not automatically better than an earlier release.
guides.drill: Before three fights, tell a teammate what opening you want and which defensive answer would stop it. Review whether you waited for that answer.

heroes.name: Pharah
heroes.biography: A soldier who uses flight equipment and explosive projectiles.

guides.title: Build a useful position
guides.body: Use roofs and obstacles to limit how many enemies can see you. Manage your flight resources around a safe landing instead of staying in a predictable open position.
guides.drill: Review one match. Pause before three engagements and identify your cover, useful target, and retreat route.

guides.title: Choose the right resource
guides.body: Pressure an angle where rockets force a useful movement. Keep Jet Dash or another movement option to answer a threatened sightline rather than using everything to approach.
guides.drill: Record three uses of the named ability. Explain the threat it answered and the option you lost by spending it.

guides.title: Coordinate the commitment
guides.body: Barrage leaves you committed to a position. Track interruption threats and use teammate pressure to create the opening; plan what happens immediately afterward.
guides.drill: Before three fights, tell a teammate what opening you want and which defensive answer would stop it. Review whether you waited for that answer.

heroes.name: Ramattra
heroes.biography: The leader of Null Sector who changes forms to control different engagement ranges.

guides.title: Build a useful position
guides.body: Use Omnic pressure from a protected position and place the barrier to block a useful enemy line. Choose Nemesis when closing distance is realistic, not merely because it is available.
guides.drill: Review one match. Pause before three engagements and identify your cover, useful target, and retreat route.

guides.title: Choose the right resource
guides.body: Use Ravenous Vortex on a route enemies need to cross. Plan where Nemesis pressure will finish so you can return to cover or support when the window ends.
guides.drill: Record three uses of the named ability. Explain the threat it answered and the option you lost by spending it.

guides.title: Coordinate the commitment
guides.body: Annihilation rewards staying in contact, but chasing beyond teammate sightlines can undo its value. Call the engagement and track enemy displacement or escape before committing.
guides.drill: Before three fights, tell a teammate what opening you want and which defensive answer would stop it. Review whether you waited for that answer.

heroes.name: Reaper
heroes.biography: A masked combatant whose identity and motives are shrouded in secrecy.

guides.title: Build a useful position
guides.body: Use a route with cover to reach close range. Make sure Wraith Form can take you toward safety after the enemy notices you.
guides.drill: Review one match. Pause before three engagements and identify your cover, useful target, and retreat route.

guides.title: Choose the right resource
guides.body: Shadow Step is a setup action, not a guarantee of surprise. Time your pressure with the front line so enemies must choose between more than one threat.
guides.drill: Record three uses of the named ability. Explain the threat it answered and the option you lost by spending it.

guides.title: Coordinate the commitment
guides.body: Death Blossom is vulnerable to defensive answers and interruption. Identify those resources before committing, and avoid giving up a safe close-range position for a low-value solo ultimate.
guides.drill: Before three fights, tell a teammate what opening you want and which defensive answer would stop it. Review whether you waited for that answer.

heroes.name: Reinhardt
heroes.biography: A German crusader who protects allies while contesting close-range space.

abilities.name: Earthshatter
abilities.description: A directional crowd-control ultimate affected by positioning and barriers.

guides.title: Build a safe position
guides.body: Advance from corner to corner. Your barrier helps cross space; cover lets it recover.
guides.drill: Play one match and record three moments where cover would have kept you safe.

guides.title: Manage your resources
guides.body: Cancel a risky charge before leaving support sightlines. Avoid chasing a target away from the objective.
guides.drill: Review three deaths and identify the defensive ability you spent too early.

guides.title: Coordinate the engagement
guides.body: Watch enemy crowd control before committing Earthshatter. Use short swings of pressure to force defensive resources.
guides.drill: Before each fight, name your target and your exit route. Review whether both were realistic.

heroes.name: Roadhog
heroes.biography: A powerful enforcer who threatens nearby enemies with a hook and shotgun.

guides.title: Build a useful position
guides.body: Play around cover with a hook angle your team can follow. The current Scrap Gun fires in two bursts, so maintain your aim through the attack instead of assuming the old firing pattern.
guides.drill: Review one match. Pause before three engagements and identify your cover, useful target, and retreat route.

guides.title: Choose the right resource
guides.body: Trash Compactor answers projectile pressure, while Take a Breather supports recovery. Decide which threat you need to handle and do not spend both resources without an exit.
guides.drill: Record three uses of the named ability. Explain the threat it answered and the option you lost by spending it.

guides.title: Coordinate the commitment
guides.body: Whole Hog can displace enemies out of an area as well as deal damage. Consider where you are pushing the target and whether that direction helps your team's objective.
guides.drill: Before three fights, tell a teammate what opening you want and which defensive answer would stop it. Review whether you waited for that answer.

heroes.name: Shion
heroes.biography: An omnic who escaped Hashimoto captivity and became one of the clan's feared Elders.

guides.title: Build a useful position
guides.body: Pressure from cover with Kira Pistols and preserve a route away from the target's teammates. Use movement to change the angle, not to stay indefinitely in close danger.
guides.drill: Review one match. Pause before three engagements and identify your cover, useful target, and retreat route.

guides.title: Choose the right resource
guides.body: Execution's tighter spread requires a deliberate aiming window. Plan Joyride's dismount and launched-bike direction before committing to a contested route.
guides.drill: Record three uses of the named ability. Explain the threat it answered and the option you lost by spending it.

guides.title: Coordinate the commitment
guides.body: Satsuriku Spree commits a sequence of rushes. Track enemy control and escape options before starting, and think through where each rush leaves your own position.
guides.drill: Before three fights, tell a teammate what opening you want and which defensive answer would stop it. Review whether you waited for that answer.

heroes.name: Sierra
heroes.biography: A Helix Security teammate whose enhanced abilities support rifle pressure and movement.

guides.title: Build a useful position
guides.body: Use sustained Helix Rifle fire from an angle with cover. The kit's accuracy behavior rewards keeping a realistic target in view, not standing exposed indefinitely.
guides.drill: Review one match. Pause before three engagements and identify your cover, useful target, and retreat route.

guides.title: Choose the right resource
guides.body: Tracking Shot marks a target for rifle tracking. Choose a target your team can pressure and avoid tunneling on a mark that moved behind strong cover.
guides.drill: Record three uses of the named ability. Explain the threat it answered and the option you lost by spending it.

guides.title: Coordinate the commitment
guides.body: Place Anchor Drone to provide a useful grapple route before danger reaches you. Trailblazer's forward path should support an engagement or contested route your team can use.
guides.drill: Before three fights, tell a teammate what opening you want and which defensive answer would stop it. Review whether you waited for that answer.

heroes.name: Sigma
heroes.biography: An astrophysicist whose gravity research left him with powers exploited by Talon.

guides.title: Build a useful position
guides.body: Use Hyperspheres around cover at a range where their delayed explosion can matter. Move your barrier to address a useful sightline rather than leaving it in one place all fight.
guides.drill: Review one match. Pause before three engagements and identify your cover, useful target, and retreat route.

guides.title: Choose the right resource
guides.body: Kinetic Grasp and the barrier answer different moments of pressure. Hold Accretion for an interrupt or target your teammates can punish, and avoid cycling every resource at once.
guides.drill: Record three uses of the named ability. Explain the threat it answered and the option you lost by spending it.

guides.title: Coordinate the commitment
guides.body: Gravitic Flux needs an engagement plan and awareness of interruption threats. Call the lifted targets and use safe positioning while your team prepares its follow-up.
guides.drill: Before three fights, tell a teammate what opening you want and which defensive answer would stop it. Review whether you waited for that answer.

heroes.name: Sojourn
heroes.biography: A former Overwatch leader determined to help its new generation avoid past mistakes.

guides.title: Build a useful position
guides.body: Build pressure from an angle with a safe Power Slide route. Aim the stored-energy shot at a target you can reasonably hit rather than keeping energy while no useful target is in sight.
guides.drill: Review one match. Pause before three engagements and identify your cover, useful target, and retreat route.

guides.title: Choose the right resource
guides.body: Use Disruptor Shot to contest a route or support your team's pressure. Save a movement choice if an enemy can reach your position while you are focusing on aim.
guides.drill: Record three uses of the named ability. Explain the threat it answered and the option you lost by spending it.

guides.title: Coordinate the commitment
guides.body: Overclock needs useful sightlines throughout its window. Change angles with your team and track defensive abilities that can deny a charged shot.
guides.drill: Before three fights, tell a teammate what opening you want and which defensive answer would stop it. Review whether you waited for that answer.

heroes.name: Soldier: 76
heroes.biography: A wanted vigilante investigating the truth behind Overwatch's collapse.

guides.title: Build a useful position
guides.body: Use Sprint to reach an angle with cover and a retreat path. Fire from a position that lets you keep a target in view without standing still in the open.
guides.drill: Review one match. Pause before three engagements and identify your cover, useful target, and retreat route.

guides.title: Choose the right resource
guides.body: Place Biotic Field where it supports a real holding position. Use Helix Rockets when a target's movement or nearby surface makes the hit realistic.
guides.drill: Record three uses of the named ability. Explain the threat it answered and the option you lost by spending it.

guides.title: Coordinate the commitment
guides.body: Tactical Visor still requires enemies in view. Check barriers, cover, and defensive abilities before committing; moving to a better lane can matter more than activating immediately.
guides.drill: Before three fights, tell a teammate what opening you want and which defensive answer would stop it. Review whether you waited for that answer.

heroes.name: Sombra
heroes.biography: A hacker who uses information and, in the current Support kit, protective utility to influence a fight.

guides.title: Build a useful position
guides.body: The current live role is Support. Keep Hotfix available for an ally under pressure, and use cover while applying short-range weapon pressure rather than following an old damage-only guide.
guides.drill: Review one match. Pause before three engagements and identify your cover, useful target, and retreat route.

guides.title: Choose the right resource
guides.body: Cyberspace can help allies and weaken enemies in a contested area. Place its zone where both effects have a realistic use, and preserve Translocator for a safe reposition.
guides.drill: Record three uses of the named ability. Explain the threat it answered and the option you lost by spending it.

guides.title: Coordinate the commitment
guides.body: Coordinate EMP with teammate pressure. Watch which deployables you can disrupt and avoid making a deep ultimate engagement that leaves your team without support.
guides.drill: Before three fights, tell a teammate what opening you want and which defensive answer would stop it. Review whether you waited for that answer.

heroes.name: Symmetra
heroes.biography: A hard-light architect who uses constructs to shape movement and sightlines.

guides.title: Build a useful position
guides.body: Use charged orbs when closing beam distance would expose you. Place turrets where they can reveal or pressure an approach without being immediately removed for free.
guides.drill: Review one match. Pause before three engagements and identify your cover, useful target, and retreat route.

guides.title: Choose the right resource
guides.body: Tell teammates where a Teleporter goes before expecting them to use it. Protect its destination and keep an exit route when committing to close-range beam pressure.
guides.drill: Record three uses of the named ability. Explain the threat it answered and the option you lost by spending it.

guides.title: Coordinate the commitment
guides.body: Photon Barrier is strongest when it divides the enemy's useful sightlines while your allies can move and shoot around it. Think about the whole fight space, not just the target in front of you.
guides.drill: Before three fights, tell a teammate what opening you want and which defensive answer would stop it. Review whether you waited for that answer.

heroes.name: Torbjörn
heroes.biography: An engineer whose weapons and turret technology helped equip Overwatch.

guides.title: Build a useful position
guides.body: Place the turret where it can cover a useful approach and survive ordinary sightline pressure. Use Rivet Gun yourself; repairing the turret is not always your best contribution.
guides.drill: Review one match. Pause before three engagements and identify your cover, useful target, and retreat route.

guides.title: Choose the right resource
guides.body: Keep Overload for a threatening engagement or an opportunity you can safely use. Reposition the turret when the fight moves rather than defending an irrelevant old angle.
guides.drill: Record three uses of the named ability. Explain the threat it answered and the option you lost by spending it.

guides.title: Coordinate the commitment
guides.body: Spread Molten Core across paths enemies need to use. Avoid putting every pool in one spot that the whole team can simply walk around.
guides.drill: Before three fights, tell a teammate what opening you want and which defensive answer would stop it. Review whether you waited for that answer.

heroes.name: Tracer
heroes.biography: A former Overwatch pilot whose time-shifting equipment gives her unusual movement.

guides.title: Build a useful position
guides.body: Take a covered approach and keep a Blink route away from danger. Pressure when teammates also demand attention, rather than entering alone before the fight begins.
guides.drill: Review one match. Pause before three engagements and identify your cover, useful target, and retreat route.

guides.title: Choose the right resource
guides.body: Track where Recall will return you. Use short bursts of pressure to draw resources, and leave before a target's teammates can surround your current position.
guides.drill: Record three uses of the named ability. Explain the threat it answered and the option you lost by spending it.

guides.title: Coordinate the commitment
guides.body: Plan a Pulse Bomb approach around movement and defensive answers. Your goal is a reliable opportunity, not a deep commitment just because the ultimate is ready.
guides.drill: Before three fights, tell a teammate what opening you want and which defensive answer would stop it. Review whether you waited for that answer.

heroes.name: Vendetta
heroes.biography: An Italian arena champion seeking control of her family's criminal legacy.

guides.title: Build a useful position
guides.body: Approach through cover until the greatsword has a realistic target. Warding Stance addresses frontal pressure and consumes a resource, so do not rely on it to solve a surrounded position.
guides.drill: Review one match. Pause before three engagements and identify your cover, useful target, and retreat route.

guides.title: Choose the right resource
guides.body: Plan Soaring Slice's destination and a safe follow-up. Whirlwind Dash creates a close commitment; check enemy movement and interruption threats before using both approach options.
guides.drill: Record three uses of the named ability. Explain the threat it answered and the option you lost by spending it.

guides.title: Coordinate the commitment
guides.body: Projected Edge spends defensive energy, so weigh its pressure against the protection you will need afterward. Coordinate Sundering Blade with teammates who can act on its frontal threat.
guides.drill: Before three fights, tell a teammate what opening you want and which defensive answer would stop it. Review whether you waited for that answer.

heroes.name: Venture
heroes.biography: An archaeologist and explorer who uses excavation equipment in combat.

guides.title: Build a useful position
guides.body: Use cover to get within a useful range for the SMART Excavator. Start Burrow with an emergence route in mind instead of treating the underground state as a plan by itself.
guides.drill: Review one match. Pause before three engagements and identify your cover, useful target, and retreat route.

guides.title: Choose the right resource
guides.body: Combine Drill Dash with a reachable target and a route back to support. Check where enemies will be when you emerge, and avoid spending every movement option to approach.
guides.drill: Record three uses of the named ability. Explain the threat it answered and the option you lost by spending it.

guides.title: Coordinate the commitment
guides.body: Tectonic Shock should threaten routes the enemy must hold or cross. Time it with teammate pressure so an opponent cannot simply back away from the whole engagement.
guides.drill: Before three fights, tell a teammate what opening you want and which defensive answer would stop it. Review whether you waited for that answer.

heroes.name: Widowmaker
heroes.biography: An assassin who uses patient long-range aim and strict control of sightlines.

guides.title: Build a useful position
guides.body: Choose an angle where a missed shot does not leave you exposed to every opponent. Keep Grappling Hook for a needed reposition when the enemy discovers your location.
guides.drill: Review one match. Pause before three engagements and identify your cover, useful target, and retreat route.

guides.title: Choose the right resource
guides.body: Use Venom Mine to watch an approach you cannot keep in your sights. Change firing angles after pressure or scouting reveals you instead of holding a predictable lane indefinitely.
guides.drill: Record three uses of the named ability. Explain the threat it answered and the option you lost by spending it.

guides.title: Coordinate the commitment
guides.body: Call information from Infra-Sight so your whole team can act on it. Track enemy movement abilities before committing to an exposed sniper angle.
guides.drill: Before three fights, tell a teammate what opening you want and which defensive answer would stop it. Review whether you waited for that answer.

heroes.name: Winston
heroes.biography: A scientist from the Horizon Lunar Colony who uses mobile barrier pressure.

abilities.name: Tesla Cannon
abilities.description: Electrical weapon pressure with distinct primary and secondary fire modes.

abilities.name: Jump Pack
abilities.description: Leap to a new position; plan a landing and an exit.

abilities.name: Barrier Projector
abilities.description: Places a barrier that can split sightlines.

abilities.name: Primal Rage
abilities.description: A transformation ultimate focused on close pressure and displacement.

guides.title: Build a safe position
guides.body: Choose a target near cover and an escape route before jumping.
guides.drill: Play one match and record three moments where cover would have kept you safe.

guides.title: Manage your resources
guides.body: Split enemy sightlines with your barrier rather than dropping it automatically on landing.
guides.drill: Review three deaths and identify the defensive ability you spent too early.

guides.title: Coordinate the engagement
guides.body: Time a dive with your damage heroes. Pressure support sightlines and leave before the enemy can surround you.
guides.drill: Before each fight, name your target and your exit route. Review whether both were realistic.

heroes.name: Wrecking Ball
heroes.biography: A resourceful hamster engineer who turned a rolling mech into a fighting machine.

guides.title: Build a useful position
guides.body: Learn a route into the fight and another route out. Use Grappling Claw to create an angle or displacement that your teammates can follow, not just to move quickly.
guides.drill: Review one match. Pause before three engagements and identify your cover, useful target, and retreat route.

guides.title: Choose the right resource
guides.body: Use Piledriver when an enemy group is actually reachable and check interruption threats first. Adaptive Shield supports a commitment but does not replace an escape plan.
guides.drill: Record three uses of the named ability. Explain the threat it answered and the option you lost by spending it.

guides.title: Coordinate the commitment
guides.body: Minefield can control movement and objective access. Coordinate the space it denies with a teammate's pressure, and avoid leaving allies exposed while you chase a separate target.
guides.drill: Before three fights, tell a teammate what opening you want and which defensive answer would stop it. Review whether you waited for that answer.

heroes.name: Wuyang
heroes.biography: A Water College support who uses healing technology and guided water attacks.

guides.title: Build a useful position
guides.body: Keep Restorative Stream on an ally who needs sustained help. Aim water orbs from cover rather than letting guided aim distract you from approaching threats.
guides.drill: Review one match. Pause before three engagements and identify your cover, useful target, and retreat route.

guides.title: Choose the right resource
guides.body: Manual healing consumes a resource. Balance it against the team's next emergency, and keep Rushing Torrent for a useful reposition when your angle becomes unsafe.
guides.drill: Record three uses of the named ability. Explain the threat it answered and the option you lost by spending it.

guides.title: Coordinate the commitment
guides.body: Use Guardian Wave to support an ally's engagement or displace an approaching threat. Tidal Blast protects a host and later detonates, so time the commitment with that delayed effect in mind.
guides.drill: Before three fights, tell a teammate what opening you want and which defensive answer would stop it. Review whether you waited for that answer.

heroes.name: Zarya
heroes.biography: A Russian athlete who uses protective barriers to build weapon pressure.

abilities.name: Particle Barrier
abilities.description: Protects Zarya and interacts with her weapon energy.

abilities.name: Projected Barrier
abilities.description: Protects an ally and interacts with weapon energy.

guides.title: Build a safe position
guides.body: Fight near corners. Use barriers to absorb meaningful pressure rather than casting them before enemies shoot.
guides.drill: Play one match and record three moments where cover would have kept you safe.

guides.title: Manage your resources
guides.body: Protect an ally during a committed action and leave resources for your own escape.
guides.drill: Review three deaths and identify the defensive ability you spent too early.

guides.title: Coordinate the engagement
guides.body: Track enemy escape and defensive abilities before Graviton Surge. Call a follow-up plan with your team.
guides.drill: Before each fight, name your target and your exit route. Review whether both were realistic.

heroes.name: Zenyatta
heroes.biography: An omnic monk who supports allies through spiritual orbs and precise projectile pressure.

guides.title: Build a useful position
guides.body: Choose a covered position with a retreat corner and an ally who can help if you are approached. Keep Harmony on a teammate whose next action will expose them to pressure.
guides.drill: Review one match. Pause before three engagements and identify your cover, useful target, and retreat route.

guides.title: Choose the right resource
guides.body: Call your Discord target so the team's pressure can align. Do not hold an open angle just to maintain an orb if enemy threats make that position unsafe.
guides.drill: Record three uses of the named ability. Explain the threat it answered and the option you lost by spending it.

guides.title: Coordinate the commitment
guides.body: Time Transcendence to answer a dangerous engagement that your allies can actually receive healing through. Track healing-denial effects and enemy displacement before relying on it as the whole defensive plan.
guides.drill: Before three fights, tell a teammate what opening you want and which defensive answer would stop it. Review whether you waited for that answer.

maps.name: Aatlis
notes: Flashpoint mode: the active objective changes, so plan a team rotation rather than leaving players behind. Check the next destination in-game before committing a route. This guide has no verified tactical coordinates for this map.

maps.name: Antarctic Peninsula
notes: Control mode: contest the active objective with a coordinated team. Regroup after a lost fight and choose a safe approach before committing; this is mode-level advice, not a marked route on this map.

maps.name: Temple of Anubis
notes: Legacy Assault listing: the source associates this map with capturing and defending successive objectives. Its availability in the current game must be checked separately. Do not treat this library entry as a current competitive rotation claim.

notes: Control mode: contest the active objective with a coordinated team. Regroup after a lost fight and choose a safe approach before committing; this is mode-level advice, not a marked route on this map.

maps.name: Ayutthaya
notes: Capture the Flag mode: coordinate the flag attempt with protection and a return plan. Check the current mode rules in-game before relying on a movement ability while carrying the flag. No specific flag route is verified for this map.

maps.name: Black Forest
notes: Elimination mode: value survival and teammate sightlines, and check the current round rules in-game. Taking an isolated duel can leave your team without that role for the rest of a fight. No map-specific position is claimed.

maps.name: Blizzard World
notes: Hybrid mode: attackers first capture an objective, then advance a payload. Reassess your positions after that transition. Defenders should plan a regroup point before the objective is lost. No specific position or sightline on this map has been verified.

maps.name: Busan
notes: Control mode: contest the active objective with a coordinated team. Regroup after a lost fight and choose a safe approach before committing; this is mode-level advice, not a marked route on this map.

maps.name: Castillo

maps.name: Château Guillard
notes: Deathmatch mode: use cover to isolate engagements and keep a retreat option. Choose fights you can finish without exposing yourself to several opponents. This is general coaching, not a verified map-specific position.
Team Deathmatch mode: group your pressure and avoid giving opponents isolated eliminations. Help a teammate finish a fight before starting another. Exact map positions are unverified.

maps.name: Circuit Royal
notes: Escort mode: attackers advance the payload while defenders contest its progress. Attackers should plan who maintains objective pressure while others take useful angles. Defenders should retreat and regroup before losing a safe fight position. Exact corners and routes on this map are unverified.

maps.name: Colosseo
notes: Push mode: fight around control of the robot and reassess the objective direction after a change in control. Avoid staggering into the next fight one player at a time. Exact shortcuts and spawn timings for this map are not verified here.

maps.name: Dorado
notes: Escort mode: attackers advance the payload while defenders contest its progress. Attackers should plan who maintains objective pressure while others take useful angles. maps.name: Esperança
notes: Push mode: fight around control of the robot and reassess the objective direction after a change in control. Avoid staggering into the next fight one player at a time. Exact shortcuts and spawn timings for this map are not verified here.

matchups.explanation: Use vertical mobility to contest Pharah and intercept eligible projectiles with Matrix; avoid leaving your backline exposed.
Use vertical access and a barrier to disrupt a sniper position. Confirm support and an exit before diving.
Healing denial can pressure Roadhog, but cleansing and cover can prevent follow-up. Keep your distance from the hook.
Particle beam pressure bypasses Defense Matrix. Mech mobility can still avoid your effective range.
Tesla pressure cannot be solved by Deflect. Keep distance and an escape route rather than dueling at close range.
Matrix does not stop the particle beam. Contest other angles and avoid a prolonged close-range duel.
Resurrection exposes you to sightlines. Use cover and check the sniper angle before committing.
Vertical pressure is difficult to reach directly. Use cover and ask ranged allies to contest her.
Suzu can answer healing denial or sleep on an ally, but timing and resource availability matter.

synergies.explanation: Nano Boost and Dragonblade can be coordinated. Plan defensive counters and the engagement before committing both ultimates.
